appDescription: Find a place to go and something to do there based on the driver's preferences. The app searches its nearby catalog or the selected sample area and shows one option at a time while driving.

function.name: FIND_BREAK_PLACE
function.description: Show outing ideas for the supplied feeling or activity preference. Accept an optional time budget or an explicit no-time-limit preference. The driver confirms navigation separately. Supply at least one of feeling or need.

need.description: The user's explicit preferred break activity: outdoor fresh air, conversation, or shelter, omitted when only a feeling is supplied.

feeling.description: The user's explicitly supplied feeling or desired experience in a nonblank phrase of at most 120 characters, omitted when no phrase was supplied.

timeMinutes.description: The available time in whole minutes from 1 to 240, omitted when the user has no time limit.

noTimeLimit.description: Whether the user explicitly has no time limit, mutually exclusive with a time budget.
